title: Mosswart Maze
subtitle: Eastham Warden quest: the Banderling Mace Head (one part of the mace)
steps: In the Facility Hub, talk to the Warden for the Mace of the Explorer.
Take the level 25 portal to the Mosswart Maze and take the Banderling Mace Head.
Combine it with the Mace Shaft from the Banderling Conquest Dungeon.
Take the Banderling Ceremonial Weapon to Olivier Rognath in the middle of Eastham.
Bring the Mace of the Explorer back to the Warden.

notes.title: Traps
notes.body: Five Whirling Blade Traps with Pressure Plates sit in the corridors. Watch the floor plates.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Mosswarts take 0.3 acid and 0.38 cold on the Chief, 0.55 slash. Fire and lightning do full damage.

notes.title: Locked chest
notes.body: One chest at the north end is locked with no key. It is not needed for the quest.
